entries.value: "The incident ledger — the alerting brain. Coalesces detections into incidents (a scan is one cluster, not sixty alarms), tracks severity and state, honours silences, and decides — once — whether an observation is worth a notification. Pure: no I/O, no clock, no database; persistence and delivery wrap it."

lead: # build.rs parses the committed graph store directly — see crates/graph-materialize/build.rs.
# PURE. No I/O, no async runtime, no HTTP/SSH, no database, no app shell. Time is
# an argument and the store is in memory, so every rule is answerable from a
# constructed sequence. Persistence (SQLite) and delivery (the tunnel) wrap this
# crate; they never live inside it.
# THE SHARED CRATE ROOT — this crate owns no source file at all. See
# crates/graph-materialize/crate_root.rs; the crate's own docs come from its record.
